 Navigation Toggle Pelicans vs. Warriors: Injury Report, Game Preview 11/9/2026
 The Pelicans visit the Golden State Warriors at the Chase Center at 9:00 pm CT on Monday.
 Pelicans.com November 9, 2026 2:52 PM CST The Pelicans travel to Golden State on Monday to face the Warriors at the Chase Center at 9:00 pm CT. The game will be broadcast on the Gulf Coast Sports and Entertainment Network. Fans can also stream the game via Pelicans+ or listen to the radio call on WWL 870 AM.
 Get the latest Pelicans-Warriors injury report, team news, tune in details, and gameday information:
 PELICANS VS WARRIORS INJURY UPDATE 
 PELICANS INJURY REPORT 
Yves Missi OUT (left knee contusion/bone bruise)
Trey Murphy III OUT (bilateral patellar tendinopathy)
Trendon Watford OUT (right ankle sprain)
Zion Williamson OUT (rest)
Malik Dia OUT (G League two-way)
Jaron Pierre Jr. OUT (G League two-way)
 WARRIORS INJURY REPORT 
Jimmy Butler III OUT (right ACL)
Moses Moody OUT (left patellar tendon)
Kristaps Porzingis OUT (not with team)
Will Richard OUT (left thumb UCL tear)
Gui Santos PROBABLE (left knee tendinitis)
Gary Payton II QUESTIONABLE (left knee inflammation)
 Clippers 139, Pelicans 123: Trey Murphy 26 points | Postgame wrap
 LA cleared 100 points before the end of the third quarter, then quickly built a 15-point lead in the final period to hand New Orleans a rare convincing loss.
